header: "ARE YOU AUTHORISED?": shown when a signed-out visitor presses the Admin button (More tools). The management pages are for the HOD of C&IT and the people he has authorised. Yes: the sign-in window opens at once (I made Yes BE the click on Sign in; the caller opens the window), and when the person has signed in the bar asks the server who they are and shows the management page they may open, or says in red that they are not authorised (the same card as for the typed word "management": src/components/ManagementHubPanel.tsx). No: back to Everything. I ask nothing of the server until the visitor has said Yes and signed in.

symbols.name: OmniAdminAsk
symbols.sig: export function OmniAdminAsk({ said, onYes, onNo }: { said: "yes" | null; onYes: () => void; onNo: () => void })

params.name: { said, onYes, onNo }
params.type: { said: "yes" | null; onYes: () => void; onNo: () => void }

behaviours: it asks 'Are you authorised to access them?' in a labelled group, says what the pages are (they change the plant's data; the HOD of C&IT and the people he has authorised), and offers Yes and a separate No
it says what each answer does: Yes signs you in and your authority is checked, No returns to the ordinary search
it is a sibling of the executive question, not the same words (it does not mention EDS, a deep search or a summary)
after Yes there is no sign-in card and no Sign in button (Yes itself opens the login window): Yes is shown as chosen and No stays
the component takes no sign-in handler (Yes is the click on Sign in)
a signed-in person who may not have the page sees a red alert saying they are not authorised to access this page
Admin is a choice of the bar, named 'Admin', that the server knows as a scope but is never a record; only the management step may run under it
it travels in the search address as scope=admin, and a line that is no management request says nothing was found under Admin and how to ask
its examples are management words: the first is the management page itself, which the server reads as such
a signed-in person who presses Admin goes straight to the check; anyone else is asked first
Yes opens the login window at once (and is remembered as said); No goes back to Everything

once signed in under Admin the question goes and the management page is asked of the server by the login (the server ignores any ticket sent by the browser): triggerSearch('semantic', { query: 'management' })
pressing any other button, opening the Utility Services, or closing the window drops the question
under Admin a typed line is sent with the Admin selection (the route answers the management words first and says nothing found for any other line); no utility, record or circular is looked at

the cross of the management page and of its refusal card, when they came from Admin, wipes the box and returns the choice to Everything (and the old way, clearSearch, stays for the typed word 'management' under Everything)

a management tool's page stands alone like the Utility Services page: the box and the choices are left out while one of the six pages is on the screen (a pure function of the answer, so it ends when Back brings the management page), and Escape goes back to the management page

the Admin button fetches the management page ahead when it is pointed at, touched or focused by a signed-in person (under the Admin address, the one the press will ask for), so the page appears at once
the route answers the management words before any scope is applied (so Admin sees the same page and the same refusals as the typed word 'management'), and the authority is the session's
